title: What is the next step once my child achieves the therapy goals at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Post Goal Achievement Process - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the next steps once your child achieves the therapy goals at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Our continuing commitment is your child's developmental growth!
html: Reaching therapy goals is always a cause for celebration at Pinnacle Blooms Network! When your child achieves their set milestones, our professional therapists conduct comprehensive reassessments to determine the next steps. Depending on your child's unique needs, this might include adjusting the goals to aim higher, focusing on new areas of development, or gradually reducing the therapy frequency while consolidating and maintaining the skills acquired. Rest assured, your child's progress and well-being remain our top priority.
